metadata.snapshot: Current working files, including uncommitted edits and nonignored additions.
metadata.scope: Existing tracked and nonignored files. Excludes graph documentation/tool itself and deleted paths. Current Git ignore rules omit local dependencies, builds, caches, environment files, blog drafts and screenshots. Tracked files remain included regardless of ignore rules; this is not content-based secret detection.
metadata.limitations: Static file references and reviewed semantic edges; not a complete call graph, runtime trace, security audit, or live deployment verification. Structural edges indicate grouping only. Package declarations do not establish usage.

nodes.label: Background location plugin
nodes.summary: BackgroundGeolocation watcher and ongoing notification.

nodes.label: npx cap sync android
nodes.summary: Copies Android www and updates native plugin integration.

nodes.label: Capacitor runtime bridge
nodes.summary: BridgeActivity hosts packaged web content and exposes native plugins.

nodes.label: SHA-256 channel identifier
nodes.summary: Client hashes a six-character code. Obfuscation, not authentication.

nodes.label: Relay container image
nodes.summary: Python 3.13 slim + requirements + main/services; one worker.

nodes.label: IndexedDB: events
nodes.summary: Auto ID; code/time index; kind + data includes participant metadata.

nodes.label: Fly deployment configuration
nodes.summary: Deployment intent in fly.toml; not proof of live infrastructure.

nodes.label: Browser geolocation
nodes.summary: GPS callbacks feed the journey session and recording.

nodes.label: Gradle Android build
nodes.summary: assembleDebug via checked-in wrapper.

nodes.label: Code-only key handshake
nodes.summary: Plaintext {hs}; names/member IDs/public keys visible. Wrapped group key. Human Allow/Deny.

nodes.label: Haptics plugin
nodes.summary: Optional native click feedback.

nodes.label: In-memory relay channels
nodes.summary: Channel ID maps to live sockets; empty channels removed. No shared cross-process bus.

nodes.label: Invite URL fragment
nodes.summary: Code + key after #; imported by client. Browser page request omits fragment.

nodes.label: IndexedDB: journeys
nodes.summary: code primary key; destination, timestamps, structured-cloned CryptoKey. Local to origin/profile; tabs sharing both share storage.

nodes.label: Journey AES-GCM key
nodes.summary: Generated/imported on a client; shared with group; not provided to relay as a key.

nodes.label: Leaflet map + routing plugins
nodes.summary: Web CDN scripts; Android bundled vendor scripts.

nodes.label: localStorage preferences
nodes.summary: Name, active journey pointer, voice, search origin, recent searches. Separate per origin/client.

nodes.label: IndexedDB: points
nodes.summary: Auto ID; code/memberId/time joins. Track samples retained locally.

nodes.label: Local relay :8000
nodes.summary: Uvicorn main:app process.

nodes.label: Render deployment configuration
nodes.summary: Deployment intent in render.yaml; not proof of live infrastructure.

nodes.label: In-memory peer roster
nodes.summary: Per session member IDs, last-seen times, location and status.

nodes.label: Sealed journey messages
nodes.summary: {iv,ct}; hello, position, quick_message, journey_config, bye. The heartbeat republishes a position or hello.

nodes.label: sessionStorage refusal message
nodes.summary: Temporary reason shown after reload.

nodes.label: Local static server :3000
nodes.summary: Serves web/frontend only.

nodes.label: Browser Web Crypto
nodes.summary: Randomness, SHA-256, AES-GCM and ECDH P-256.

nodes.label: app-debug.apk
nodes.summary: Expected ignored output of assembleDebug; this graph does not rebuild it.

nodes.label: GPX download
nodes.summary: A track per member.

nodes.label: Journey JSON download
nodes.summary: Metadata, participants, points, events; excludes encryption key.

nodes.label: Capacitor packaged web assets
nodes.summary: Ignored android/app/src/main/assets/public copied from Android www by cap sync.

nodes.label: GET /v1/health
nodes.summary: Relay liveness endpoint.

nodes.label: OSRM route service
nodes.summary: Route coordinates are sent to routing.openstreetmap.de.

nodes.label: Photon destination search
nodes.summary: Query and optional latitude/longitude/bounding box leave the device.

nodes.label: WS /v1/relay/{channel_id}
nodes.summary: Opaque text-frame relay. It sees sealed envelopes and plaintext handshake envelopes.

nodes.label: GET /
nodes.summary: Compatibility health endpoint in addition to documented v1 API.

nodes.label: Stadia map tiles
nodes.summary: Live and replay tile requests reveal the viewed area.
